item.title: White House Defends AI Chip Export Controls Amid Industry Pushback
item.description: Administration officials defended the new AI chip export restrictions to China, arguing the controls on artificial intelligence chip technology protect national security.

item.title: Quantum Computing Error Correction Milestone Draws Scrutiny
item.description: Independent researchers are reviewing claims of an error-corrected qubits milestone in quantum computing, questioning whether the results can be replicated.

item.title: Investors Pour Money Into Error-Corrected Quantum Computing Startups
item.description: Venture capital is flowing into quantum computing startups following claims of an error-corrected qubits breakthrough earlier this week.

item.title: Rival Firms Race to Match New Satellite Constellation Launch
item.description: Competing companies are accelerating their own orbital launch plans after a rival's satellite constellation launch dominated headlines this week.

item.title: Gene-Editing Therapy Trial Shows Promising Early Results
item.description: A gene-editing therapy trial using CRISPR technology reported promising early results for patients with a rare genetic blood disorder.

item.title: Regulators Scrutinize Gene-Editing Therapy Trial Data
item.description: Health regulators are closely reviewing data from the gene-editing therapy trial before deciding on approval for wider use.
